title: Character art correction references
scope: Prepared correction brief and reference links. No character art has been generated. Planned deliverables are single poses; walking animation is outside scope. No completed-art count or pack manifest is available. Linked publisher and official images are references only and are not redistributed.

evidenceTiers.label: Primary text
evidenceTiers.meaning: Direct book text or an authorized publisher sample can support only the traits it explicitly shows or states.

evidenceTiers.label: Licensed illustration
evidenceTiers.meaning: Official tabletop illustrations or miniatures guide adaptation design; they do not establish that every visual detail is novel text canon.

evidenceTiers.label: Secondary index
evidenceTiers.meaning: A reference index or summary reports book traits and locators. Treat as provisional until checked against primary text.

evidenceTiers.label: User-directed design choice
evidenceTiers.meaning: Explicit art target for this correction; not a claim that the trait is stated in the books.
